evidence: Follow the track behind the hut and climb, before sidling around above the gorge to the open flats of the south branch.

Follow the valley through the alpine herb fields for about an hour, to reach Rabbit Pass (1430 metres), to follow the obvious shelf east, and climb towards Mt Lois for about 30 minutes until a narrow rock slide leading down through the bluffs.
It’s an easy 1 to 2 hours to Ruth Flat.
Here it descends to the river and Junction Flat, 4 - 5 hours from Ruth Flat.
From here follow the flats to the West Matukituki River, ford the river to Cameron Flat or, if the river is too high to cross safely, use the bridge an hour upstream.

doubts: The page describes the traverse only from Top Forks Hut; it does not say how one reaches Top Forks Hut or whether the route is ever walked in reverse. The end is Cameron Flat (T6, a valley name); road ends F1/F2 on Cameron Flat Road are nearby but the text names no road end. The section times (8 - 10 hr and 7 - 9 hr) do not match DOC's overall '7 - 10 hr'; DOC's time is copied. If the West Matukituki is too high, the text says use the bridge an hour upstream, which changes the final approach. 'East Matukituki Track' (T1) is assumed to be the track on the true right of the East Matukituki River.
